=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5289-5291, 5502-5517 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `pre_implement_run_id` is read from `actions/workflows/implement.yml/runs`. `implement.yml` is `workflow_call`-only, so the snapshot is always 0. As a result `select(.id > ${PRE_IMPLEMENT:-0})` filters nothing, `all(.workflow_runs[]; .id > 0)` is always true, the "reaches the pre-create snapshot id" stop never fires, and the alt-model loop has no time window and only stops on a short page or the 5-page (500-run) cap.
  WHY: The title filter still prevents wrong cancels, but a pending Implement run is silently missed if more than 500 runs were created after the issue. The step comment (5504-5510) and the agents.d fragment describe a scoping mechanism that does not exist. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3=MAJOR, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash=NIT; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5518-5520 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The stop predicate in the alt-model run scan that cancels Implement runs is effectively reversed.
  WHY: The scan exits before it reaches the pre-create run ID while runs are newer than the snapshot, so Implement runs are not cancelled and open stranded PRs. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute this: they state the loop correctly continues while every id is newer and breaks once a page contains an id at or below the snapshot.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4877-4893 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The branch-deletion probe treats any stderr text containing "HTTP 404" as "branch already absent" and does not check the exit code (`PROJECT_BRANCH_PROBE_EXIT`).
  WHY: A proxy- or wrapper-injected message containing "HTTP 404" could misclassify a real failure, which would end the retry loop early without a `::warning::`. Severity disagreement: gemini=MAJOR, minimax=NIT; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes this: gh reports 401/403/5xx as "(HTTP 4xx/5xx)", so those still retry and warn.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3756-3760 (and alt-model equivalent at 5518-5520) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The page loop breaks silently on any API failure (rate limit, scope or 5xx).
  WHY: One transient error on page N skips cancelling every run from page N to 10, which leaves stranded PRs until the sweep backstop closes them hours later.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:543-1052 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The required job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` (check run 43079680894 / job 130728623883 on head 9d44bb7) failed. Its log tail ends in fixture `::error::[lint_pr_body_auto_close] ... #2734` output from `tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py`, and the failing step is not identified.
  WHY: The `lint` aggregate gate (ci.yml:3459) stays red and blocks merge. The failure cannot be mapped to any hunk in this diff; the evidence suggests inherited failures or a runner-level kill/timeout (container_rc_137).
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_alt_model_cleanup_pr_selector.py:213-258 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new static-text assertions pin `all(.workflow_runs[]; .id > ${PRE_IMPLEMENT:-0})` and `select(.id > ${PRE_IMPLEMENT:-0})`, which only work because the snapshot is 0, and the alt-model loop has no execution-style test.
  WHY: The test gives a false sense of coverage, and a future fix that makes PRE_IMPLEMENT real will either still pass by accident or lose its pinning value.
- agents.d/8953-smoke-pr-cleanup.md:6 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says the alt-model cleanup cancels Implement runs "newer than the pre-create snapshot id", but PRE_IMPLEMENT is always 0 and no time window is applied.
  WHY: An operator debugging a stale Implement run would be sent to a snapshot mechanism that does not exist.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5502-5517 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: With PRE_IMPLEMENT=0, every alt-model cleanup reads up to 5 full pages (500 runs), and most of them are unrelated to the smoke issue.
  WHY: The API budget is about 500 runs per cleanup instead of the intended ~100; this is not a hot path.
- (gate harness; no repo file):pre-push gate report for head 9d44bb7 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate's "Failures caused by this change" list (fragment/changelog contract tests, gh_api_write_guard (5), files_touched_scope_guard, shellcheck, among others) cannot be caused by this diff; the causes are environmental, e.g. `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` is absent from the workspace.
  WHY: The classification is unreliable, and treating these items as merge blockers would push editors to churn correct code. Real CI shows `static-checks: success`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The job also runs tests that are inherited failures (ci.yml:962, 1035, 1044, 1045), and none of its steps runs a file this PR changed.
  WHY: The `lint` gate (ci.yml:3459) stays red and blocks merge. The failure cannot be mapped to a hunk in this diff, and an editor change to this PR's files will not clear it.

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:lines 5502-5517 (Cleanup alt-model artifacts), with `PRE_IMPLEMENT` sourced via line 5478 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The snapshot is read from `implement.yml/runs`, which is `workflow_call`-only and owns no runs, so it is always 0. `select(.id > 0)` matches every run, `all(...; .id > 0)` is vacuously true, and the loop stops only on a short page or the 5-page cap.
  WHY: On a busy test repo the cleanup uses the full 5-page budget, and the documentation drift misleads anyone debugging a missed cancel. Note: the reviewer states the "inverted predicate" consensus claim is incorrect.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_alt_model_cleanup_pr_selector.py:lines 213-258 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new static assertions pin predicates that only work because PRE_IMPLEMENT=0, and there is no execution-style test for the alt-model loop.
  WHY: The test gives a false sense of coverage, and a future snapshot fix will either pass by accident or lose its pinning value.
- agents.d/8953-smoke-pr-cleanup.md:line 6 paragraph 2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Documentation drift: the fragment describes a "newer than the pre-create snapshot id" scope that does not exist.
  WHY: An operator or reviewer would be sent to a snapshot mechanism that does not exist.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:lines 4879-4883 (PROJECT_BRANCH_PROBE_ERR capture, "Cleanup orchestrate test issues") | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `*"HTTP 404"*` substring match could short-circuit the retry loop if a proxy or wrapper prepends "HTTP 404" to a different error; `PROJECT_BRANCH_PROBE_EXIT` should also be required to be non-zero.
  WHY: A transient auth or scope failure could log "already absent" and skip the retries and the `::warning::`; the probability is low.
